One proportionately sized warehouse worker in the SAME blue-orange uniform as existing workers walks beside trolley toward dispatch to the right, alert neutral pleasant face, natural adult proportions, softly shaded face and hands and dimensional clothing folds. Keep worker small and integrated into warehouse, same scale as original workers, NOT a large character pasted in foreground. This is the long separate journey from receiving on left to dispatch on right. Preserve all three rack rows and all original shelf signs, receiving and dispatch doors, desk, wall and roof beams and camera. Do not add other people. No doodles, no labels, no extra signs, no floating symbols. Critical: final output must look like precisely the same illustrator rendered the input warehouse, with ONLY the forklift replaced by this worker with trolley. Preserve soft three-dimensional illustrated volume and fine edge treatment.
